collision_audit.limits: Historical audit covers its registered inputs; not a proof about unknown jobs or internal training reset streams. Recheck registered bank usage before later execution.

pairing: Within one length/density/replicate only; methods and fractions share roads. Length is part of schema.pairing_key. Never pool lengths or claim cross-length pairing from numeric seeds.
reuse: L1000 E5 uses existing main B1 observations with identical science dependencies and mechanism logs. L2000 B1 is always newly evaluated.
